ENGL 102: Literature and Culture
Fall Term 2026
Department of English and Film Studies, University of Alberta

Course Overview:
Critical reading and writing focused on representative literary texts across poetry, drama, and narrative fiction.

Course Schedule & Due Dates:

Week 1-2: Foundations of Literary Analysis
- Wednesday, September 16, 2026: Diagnostic Essay due by 11:59 PM (5% of final grade).

Week 3-5: Close Reading and Short Fiction
- Wednesday, October 07, 2026: Close Reading Essay due by 11:59 PM (15% of final grade).

Week 6-8: Drama and Cultural Contexts
- Wednesday, October 28, 2026: Midterm Reflection in-class writing assessment (15% of final grade).

Week 9-11: Research and Argumentation
- Wednesday, November 18, 2026: Research Paper Draft due for instructor review (10% of final grade).
- Wednesday, November 25, 2026: Peer Review Feedback workshop submission (5% of final grade).

Week 12-13: Revisions and Culmination
- Monday, December 07, 2026: Final Research Paper due via eClass (25% of final grade).
- Tuesday, December 15, 2026: Final Portfolio submission deadline (25% of final grade).

All assignments are evaluated using rubrics distributed on eClass.
